content.short: Index Coop is a DeFi DAO that creates and manages diversified crypto index products and structured assets.
content.description: Index Coop is a leading decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) focused on making crypto investing accessible through diversified index products. By aggregating top-tier protocols into single-token exposures, such as the DeFi Pulse Index (DPI), the platform allows users to gain broad market exposure with a single transaction. This simplifies the investment process, reduces gas costs, and provides institutional-grade asset management. Governed by the INDEX token, the community-led protocol researches and launches products tailored to the evolving decentralized economy.
content.meta: Index Coop provides diversified crypto index tokens and decentralized asset management. Discover Index Coop and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
